title: Crix
tagline: Cricket reimagined: every inch of the field now holds a story, every angle an opportunity. No shot is just a stroke, no delivery just a ball. Precision and possibility merge, making every moment a chance to redefine the game. Welcome to cricket's new dimension.
description:
Experience the future of cricket fantasy with Crix, a groundbreaking platform redefining the existing cricket fantasy landscape. Unlike traditional models, Crix introduces an innovative, zone-based prediction system that lets you bet on the exact spot where the ball lands on the field. This new form of betting amplifies the excitement, turning each delivery into an opportunity for strategic insight. With Crix, you're not just predicting outcomes—you’re pinpointing them.
Our native token, CRX, ensures seamless transactions and rewards your participation, making your gameplay as rewarding as it is thrilling. Dive into this unparalleled betting experience and let your cricket intuition pay off like never before.
how_its_made:
Crix is an innovative Cricket Fantasy Game that redefines traditional gameplay by integrating the unique concept of Zonal Division within the cricket ground. While most existing prediction markets focus on scores and individual player performance, Crix introduces a fresh dynamic by allowing predictions based on predefined zones of the field. These zones, commonly referenced by commentators to indicate where a ball lands for a score of 4, 6, or a catch, are well-recognized among cricket enthusiasts.

Players place bets on both the score and the specific zone. If their prediction matches the actual result, they win, and the total prize pool from all participants for that particular ball is shared equally among the winners.

User onboarding is seamless, requiring only a simple wallet connection. Any wallet compatible with Chiliz and Mantle networks can be used. The entire web application is hosted on the Chiliz Chain, with 1 CRX (our native token) equating to 0.001 CHZ. For times when live matches are unavailable, Crix features simulated matches with outcomes generated on-chain using Pyth Entropy, ensuring fair and transparent randomization for scores and zones.
